name: Wei Zhang
bio: Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Initially trained as a materials scientist, a university project involving composite materials for racing bicycles sparked his interest in aerodynamics. He transitioned to motorsport, cutting his teeth at a Formula 3 team before moving into Formula 1 development roles. Wei believes in a data-driven approach, emphasizing rigorous testing and simulation to optimize aerodynamic performance. His calm demeanor and methodical problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset in high-pressure environments. He is known for his ability to distill complex data into actionable insights.

physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing rectangular glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on a 'tea break' every afternoon at 3 PM, regardless of ongoing deadlines.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
